(Left) 6 8 2 1 4 8 7 1 3 7 2 4 8 9 5 4 3 5 2 7 (Right) How many such digits are there each of which is immediately preceded by a perfect square and immediately followed by an odd digit? (NOTE: 1 is also a perfect square.)

questions.question: Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.) (5, 18, 24) (9, 22, 28)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.
(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
(5, 18, 24)
(9, 22, 28)
questions.solution:
The pattern is to check the difference between the second and the first number, and then between the third and the first number.

For (5, 18, 24):

18 − 5 = 13 and 24 − 5 = 19

For (9, 22, 28):

22 − 9 = 13 and 28 − 9 = 19

The differences are the same in both sets: 13 and 19.

Check option 3 (8, 21, 27):

21 − 8 = 13 and 27 − 8 = 19

This matches the pattern.

Other options do not match this pattern.

So, the correct answer is option 3.

questions.question: All the individual letters in the word PICKLED are arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical order between the letter which is second from the left and the one which is fourth from the right in the new letter cluster thus formed?
questions.questionHtml: All the individual letters in the word PICKLED are arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical order between the letter which is second from the left and the one which is fourth from the right in the new letter cluster thus formed?
questions.solution:
PICKLED → arranged alphabetically:

C, D, E, I, K, L, P

Second from the left = D
Fourth from the right = I

Now count the letters between D and I in the English alphabetical order:

D, E, F, G, H, I

Letters between D and I = E, F, G, H = 4

Answer: 4

questions.question: In a row of 45 people facing north, Pari is 14ᵗʰ from the right end. If Bittu sits 20ᵗʰ to the left of Pari, what is Bittu’s position from the left end of the line?
questions.questionHtml: In a row of 45 people facing north, Pari is 14ᵗʰ from the right end. If Bittu sits 20ᵗʰ to the left of Pari, what is Bittu’s position from the left end of the line?
questions.solution:
Pari's position from right end = 14

Total people = 45

Pari's position from left end = 45 − 14 + 1 = 32

Bittu is 20th to the left of Pari

Bittu's position from left end = 32 − 20 = 12

Hence, Bittu is 12th from the left end

Final answer: Option 4
